step1_analysis.description: This circuit appears to be a sub-block of an energy-harvesting charge pump, likely functioning as a level shifter, clock driver, or adaptive dead-time controller. It utilizes cross-coupled and cascoded transistor structures to manage voltage levels and timing.

paper_reference.title: A 0.15V-Input Energy-Harvesting Charge Pump with Switching Body Biasing and Adaptive Dead-Time for Efficiency Improvement

power_consumption.description: Average power consumed by the circuit during switching operation.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_avg. With VDD=1.8V and typical switching currents in the uA range, power is expected to be in the uW range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply compared to the ultra-low voltage (0.15V) of the original paper.

voltage_swing.description: Maximum voltage swing at the internal/output nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing should be close to rail-to-rail (0 to 1.8V) depending on the logic state.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CMOS logic levels for 1.8V supply.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify switching behavior and measure power consumption of the sub-circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Charge Pump Sub-circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* Supply and Inputs
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 100p 100p 5n 10n)
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 PULSE(0 1.8 2.5n 100p 100p 5n 10n)
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 PULSE(0 1.8 5n 100p 100p 5n 10n)
VLABEL_NET_6 LABEL_NET_6 0 PULSE(0 1.8 7.5n 100p 100p 5n 10n)

* DUT
XM1 GND LABEL_NET_0 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 N2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N1 N5 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N3 LABEL_NET_4 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 LABEL_NET_5 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Load Capacitors to aid convergence and simulate parasitic load
C1 N5 0 10f
C2 N0 0 10f
C3 N1 0 10f
C4 N2 0 10f
C5 N3 0 10f

.control
tran 100p 40n

* Measure Voltage Swings
meas tran v_max_n0 max v(N0)
meas tran v_min_n0 min v(N0)
meas tran v_max_n5 max v(N5)
meas tran v_min_n5 min v(N5)

* Measure Power Consumption
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD)
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

quit
.endc
.end
